You can use models to compare the fractions.

$\frac{15}{20}$ — 15 out of 20 equal parts are shaded.

$\frac{7}{20}$ — 7 out of 20 equal parts are shaded.
Both shapes have 20 equal parts and are the same size. So, the parts in one shape are equal in size to the parts in the other.

When parts are the same size, fewer parts means a smaller fraction.

So, less of the second shape is shaded.

$\frac{7}{20}$ is less than $\frac{15}{20}$.
